newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Gardenia subscription price set at 1,465 forints.
newsitem.headline: Gardenia subscription price set at 1,465 forints.

text.p: The subscription price in an upcoming share issue in Hungarian curtain factory Gardenia Rt was set at 1,465 forints/share, the official bourse gazette said on Monday.

Gardenia, a candidate for listing on the Budapest Stock Exchange, will make a combined transaction which includes the sale of 222,000 shares with 500 forints face value and the issue of 400,000 new shares, it said.
All shares are registered and ordinary and the subscription period will run between March 10 and 21.
Gardenia's current issued share capital is one billion forints.
Gardenia said in February that the capital increase was aimed at financing the company's expansion plans.
The company, based in Gyor, west Hungary, wants to build a new plant, buy new machinery and make acquisitions in the area of home textiles.
Monday's statement said that Hofmann Schneider Securities will be the lead manager of the transaction and will be helped by MKB Securities.
Gardenia lodged its request on February 17 for listing its shares in the listed "A" category of the Budapest Stock Exchange, and said it expected the listing to start in April.
